tina-simone-mckinnor.text: Voted aye on AB 1078 (firearms) on the Assembly floor, 57-20 on concurrence, 9/11/2025.
Voted aye on SB 704 (firearm barrels) on the Assembly floor, 57-20, 9/8/2025.

source.title: Bill Votes - SB 704 Firearms: firearm barrels (leginfo.legislature.ca.gov)

tina-simone-mckinnor.text: Voted aye on SB 627, which makes it a crime for a peace officer to wear a facial covering while performing duties, with exceptions; Assembly floor 45-23, 9/9/2025.

source.title: Bill Votes - SB 627 Law enforcement: masks (leginfo.legislature.ca.gov)

tina-simone-mckinnor.text: Voted aye on SB 98 (schools and colleges: immigration enforcement notification) on the Assembly floor, 59-10, 9/2/2025.

source.title: Bill Votes - SB 98 Education: immigration enforcement: notification (leginfo.legislature.ca.gov)

tina-simone-mckinnor.text: Voted aye on AB 1340 (rideshare driver labor relations) on the Assembly floor, 54-15 on 6/4/2025 and 60-15 on concurrence 9/9/2025.

source.title: Bill Votes - AB 1340 Transportation network company drivers: labor relations (leginfo.legislature.ca.gov)

tina-simone-mckinnor.text: Authored AB 288, signed 9/30/2025. It lets California's Public Employment Relations Board act on private-sector union and labor complaints when the federal NLRB cannot. She said workers' right to organize 'is essential to the state's economic security.'

source.title: Asm. McKinnor Legislation to Protect California Workers' Right to Organize Signed into Law

tina-simone-mckinnor.text: Introduced a three-bill renter package in March 2026: AB 1963 (reusable tenant screening reports, capped screening costs), AB 2350 (ban on 'Rent Now, Pay Later' lending) and AB 2616 (82-degree maximum indoor temperature in rentals).

source.title: Assemblymember McKinnor Introduces Legislative Package to Lower Housing Costs and Protect Renters Across California

tina-simone-mckinnor.text: Authored AB 628, requiring new residential leases to include a working stove and refrigerator; final Assembly approval 45-13 on 9/11/2025. She called them 'a necessary part of modern life.'

source.title: Assemblymember McKinnor Measure Requiring New Residential Leases to Include a Stove and Refrigerator Approved by State Legislature

tina-simone-mckinnor.text: Voted aye on AB 130 (housing budget trailer bill) on the Assembly floor, 53-17 on 3/20/2025 and 62-3 on concurrence 6/30/2025. She did not vote on SB 79 (transit-oriented development) on 9/11/2025 (NVR).
Authored AB 57, dedicating ten percent of the state's Home Purchase Assistance Program to descendants of formerly enslaved people; final Assembly vote 58-10, 9/9/2025.

source.title: Nation's First Homebuyer Assistance Fund for Descendants of Formerly Enslaved People Approved by California State Legislature

tina-simone-mckinnor.text: Introduced AB 2186 to exempt reparations benefits from California personal income tax from 2027 through 2032, citing 'lower taxes for hard working residents.'

source.title: Assemblymember Tina McKinnor Declares No Taxation on Reparations

tina-simone-mckinnor.text: Voted aye on SB 840 (Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund studies, urgency) on the Assembly floor, 59-15, 9/13/2025.

source.title: Bill Votes - SB 840 Greenhouse gases: Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund: studies (leginfo.legislature.ca.gov)

tina-simone-mckinnor.text: Joined legislators denouncing the Ninth Circuit ruling on federalized National Guard use in California: 'End this federal government's occupation of California now.'

source.title: California Legislative Leaders Respond to Ninth Circuit Ruling Allowing President to Continue Illegal Use of National Guard
